About

I build the tool I wished I had

I'm a second-year Computer Science student at JSPM Rajarshi Shahu College of Engineering, Pune — graduating in 2029, with a CGPA of 8.5 in my first year. Most of what I build starts from a real, annoying problem — the kind you only notice if you've lived through it.

SmartEDU turns live lectures into structured study material — subtitles, notes, quizzes, exam questions, and a lecture chatbot, all generated automatically using Gemini and Groq. Won 3rd place at E-Cell startup event. CheatGPT turns any PDF into exam-ready cheat sheets — 200+ users, custom .in domain, live on Railway + Vercel. GaonKaam connects daily-wage workers with local employers using voice input, Indic languages, and Deepgram's speech-to-text.

I work end to end — React on the frontend, FastAPI and Firebase for backend, Gemini and Groq for AI intelligence, Vercel and Railway to ship. My goal is to build AI products that solve real problems, explore agentic AI systems, and eventually work on model training. I care more about whether it works for a real person than whether the demo looks good.

Research & Interests

Where I go deep

∿
AI-Based Noise Filtering for Indian Classrooms

Conducted research on the application of AI-driven noise filtering and signal processing techniques to improve audio clarity in Indian classroom environments — where background noise, acoustics, and multilingual speech patterns create unique challenges. Analysed how DSP and ML models can be applied to enhance learning outcomes in real-world low-resource settings.

Signal ProcessingAudio MLEdTechIndian Classrooms
⌬
Multilingual Voice Interfaces for Low-Literacy Users

How do you build software for someone who can speak but not read? GaonKaam pushed me to think hard about voice-first UX, icon-driven flows, and Indic language support. Exploring accessible design patterns for Tier-3 India — where the next billion users are.

AccessibilityVoice UIIndic LanguagesRural Tech
⬡
Agentic AI Systems & Model Training

Deeply interested in how autonomous AI agents plan, reason, and take multi-step actions to complete complex goals. Currently exploring agentic architectures, prompt chaining, and tool-use patterns. Long-term goal: contribute to AI model training and build products that leverage agentic AI at their core.
